Sam (CSM): Heads-up: Borealis (acct: BRL-44) renewal in 10 days. Procurement asking to switch billing to Borealis EU and pay by wire. PO expired. @Noah can you confirm payer and signer?

Noah (AE): Pinged procurement (procurement@borealis.ai). Last signer was Helen (CFO). They said EU entity preferred but will confirm VAT ID.

Irene (Finance): If EU billed we need VAT ID + remit IBAN. Wire ok. Also prefer invoice PDF attached to DocuSign.

Vik (Legal): If they change entity, we need amendment to reflect billing entity and VAT recitals. Also include bank-confirmation anti-fraud clause.

Sam (CSM): Customer requests shortened term 12 -> 10 months and prorate. Quick estimate: base prorated = $75,000, support add-on = $6,000, credit -$3,000. Subtotal $78,000.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope created by Noah  env-brl44-1 - draft.

Noah (AE): I'll add Helen as signer and request IBAN + VAT ID fields. @Irene can you draft invoice with IBAN placeholder?

Irene (Finance): Drafting now. Invoice will state billing entity: Borealis EU OU (need VAT ID). Payment terms Net 30, wire preferred.

Vik (Legal): Approve amendment language: "Provisioning contingent on receipt of cleared wire or bank confirmation; Redwood may delay provisioning pending verification."

Sam (CSM): Proposed timeline: issue invoice 2025-05-05, sign by 2025-05-08, onboarding start 2025-05-20. If docs delayed, offer 1-week limited access grace.

Noah (AE): Procurement replied: VAT ID = EU-55443322, will attach bank confirmation once invoice PDF received. Signing expected 48 hours after invoice.

Irene (Finance): Invoice PDF ready with IBAN masked. Sending to Noah to attach to envelope. Remit to: Redwood Bank (details on PDF).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Envelope env-brl44-1 updated - recipient Helen@borealis.ai added, awaiting signature.

Noah (AE): Helen signed within 12 hours. Procurement to send wire; estimated clearing 2 business days.

Irene (Finance): Please send payment receipt to finance@redwood.com once wire initiated. We'll mark order active after funds confirmation.

Sam (CSM): Great work. Closing checklist: 1) confirm wire cleared; 2) send provisioning note to infra; 3) log amendment in CRM. I'll keep slot reserved until 2025-05-18. Flag here for blockers.

Noah (AE): Will update when wire confirmed. :thumbsup:
